question: Indian dancer Pandit Birju Maharaj was an exponent of which of the following Kathak gharanas?
solution:
The Correct Answer is **__Lucknow__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was an exponent of **Lucknow Gharanas.**
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj was a recipient of **Padma Vibhushan **in the year **1986**.
 
• He Also Taught at Kathak Kendra(a unit of Sangeet Natak Akademi).
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some Famous Classical Dance forms of India:
 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Tamil Nadu.
 
• Manipuri Dance, Manipur.
 
• Kathak.
 
• Odissi Dance, Orissa.
 
• Kathakali. 
 
• Mohiniattam. 
 
• Kuchipudi (Southern India).
 
• Sattriya Dance.
